data.name: Nudrat
data.gender_notes: Nudrat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A delightful and joyful name, symbolizing happiness and contentment. The name Nudrat carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nudrat usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that brings joy and delight to those around her.
data.etymology: Nudrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nudrat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ندرة
in_arabic.meaning: الندرة تعني الرفعة و العلو و الزيادة في الخير و الجمال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ندرة مشتق من الجذر ن-د-ر و يعني الرفعة و العلو و الزيادة في الخير و الجمال. يستخدم في اللغة العربية لوصف الشخص أو الشيء الذي يتميز بالتفرد و الارتفاع في المكانة و القيمة. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَنُدْرِسُ الْأَدِلَّةَ وَنُقَلِّبُ الْعَلاماتِ' (سورة البقرة: ۲٥٣) أي نرفع و نزيد في الأدلة و العلامات. و في السنة النبوية، روى ابن ماجه عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه قال: 'كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه و سلم يقول: إذا سمعتم الأذان فقولوا مثل ما يقول المؤذن' و في رواية أخرى: 'فإنها ندرة في الجنة'.

in_urdu.name: ندرت
in_urdu.meaning: ندرت کا مطلب ہے اونچائی، شان، خوبی اور عظمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام ندرت عربی جڑ ن-د-ر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اونچائی، شان، خوبی اور عظمت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں بڑے احترام و تقدیر کے ساتھ استعمال ہوتا ہے کیونکہ یہ کسی فرد یا چیز کی بلندیاں اور خوبیاں بیان کرتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی علماء اور بزرگوں کے مابین مقبول رہا ہے جو اپنے علم اور روحانی قابلیتوں کے لئے جانے جاتے تھے۔

in_hindi.name: नुद्रत
in_hindi.meaning: नुद्रत का अर्थ है ऊंचाई, सुंदरता और महानता
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम नुद्रत अरबी मूल से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है ऊंचाई, सुंदरता और महानता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह किसी व्यक्ति की विशेषताओं और आत्मिक ऊंचाइयों को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, नुद्रत नाम की एक आध्यात्मिक गहराई है जो इसे पवित्र और महान बनाती है।

in_pashto.name: نډرت
in_pashto.meaning: نډرت د لوړوالي، ښکلا او عظمت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د نډرت نوم د عربي ژبې له ريښې ن-د-ر څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې معنی يې لوړوالی، ښکلا او عظمت دی. په پښتني روایت کې، دا نوم د احترام او عزت سره کارول کېږي ځکه چې دا د شخص د لوړوالي او ښکلاګانو څرګندولو لپاره کارول کېږي. په تاريخي توګه، دا نوم د پښتنو علماء او مشرانو په منځ کې مشهور دی چې د خپلو علمي او روحاني وړتیاوو لپاره پيژندل شوي دي.

in_english.name: Nudrat
in_english.meaning: Nudrat means elevation, beauty, and greatness in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nudrat originates from the Arabic root 'n-d-r' which signifies elevation, beauty, and greatness. It is used to describe someone or something distinguished by uniqueness and high esteem. The term appears in the Quran, such as in Surah Al-Baqarah: 'And We bring forth evidence and turn over the signs' (2:253), implying an increase and elevation in signs and proofs. In Islamic tradition, Nudrat holds spiritual significance, representing a person's elevated status and moral excellence.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Nudrat" evokes a sense of warmth, joy, and beauty in the Islamic culture. This name signifies the ability to find happiness in the small joys of life and to experience profound contentment. It is a name that can uplift the bearer and those around them, bringing a positive energy and atmosphere.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Nudrat" symbolizes the manifestation of the Divine Grace in one's life. It reflects the deep inner satisfaction that comes from connecting with the Creator and walking in His ways. It is a reminder that true happiness and contentment come not from material possessions or Earthly pursuits, but from a strong bond with the Almighty. The name "Nudrat" invites us to cultivate inner peace and joy, to find solace in the love and mercy of Allah, and to share His blessings with the world around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Delight, Joy" symbolizes A delightful and joyful name, symbolizing happiness and contentment.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nudrat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of delight, joy.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nudrat was a Persian princess in the 7th century who is known for her beauty and wisdom. The name Nudrat carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nudrat remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
